title: ever MARINA|Rhinestone Embellished Chiffon Lantern Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This chiffon formal evening dress features a radiant rhinestone waist detail and softly draped bodice that defines the waist while skimming over the tummy and hips. The airy lantern sleeves add elegant coverage and movement, so you feel polished (not restricted) from ceremony to dance floor. A floor-length skirt flows beautifully in photos—perfect for mother of the bride/groom looks, black-tie weddings, galas, evening receptions, and formal parties. Grab your size before it’s gone.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
